intent: 测试评估 paperbanana-clean 的提示词、UI文字说明、示例、角色状态流转、交接机制、停止机制

ui-auditor.findings: i18n coverage ~85%, hardcoded strings in ErrorBoundary/EmptyState

prompt-auditor.findings: Style Guide severely abbreviated (~50 vs ~2000 words), missing Lite Mode

flow-auditor.findings: State machine correct, image data deep-copied multiple times

stop-auditor.findings: No Cancel API, useGenerate lacks abort, Python SIGKILL only

qa-synthesizer.findings: Comprehensive report generated, gate decision: REVIEW

key_findings: C1: 无 Cancel API 端点 - 用户无法停止运行中的任务
C2: useGenerate 缺少 AbortController - 单次生成无法停止
C3: Style Guide 严重压缩 (~50词 vs Python ~2000词)
H1: 图像数据多次深拷贝 (500KB-2MB)
H2: EmptyState 组件未使用 i18n
Go 架构优于 Python，但需修复关键缺陷
recommendation: 修复 3 个 Critical 问题后可发布，预计 3-4 天工作量
